description: This file is a CodeMirror addon script named 'continuecomment.js' that implements functionality to continue comments in the editor, supporting block and line comments, with configurable options.

methods.name: continueComment
methods.description: Main function to handle continuing comments in the CodeMirror editor.

methods.name: nonspaceAfter
methods.description: Helper function to find the index of the first non-space character after a given position in a string.

methods.name: continueLineCommentEnabled
methods.description: Checks if continuing line comments is enabled based on editor options.
